name: regexunicode
algorithm: FindAll of \pL+, \w+\s\pL and \p{Lu}\pL* (large UTF-8 classes) over a whole 50 MB log, rounds times, summing a million plus each match's length (README.md).

skip.c: no std regex in C (POSIX regex.h is not ISO C, and the MSVC CRT has none)
skip.rust: no std regex in Rust (the regex crate is not std; no crate stands in)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the checksum, far below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own engine; the checksum (a million per match plus its length) checks that both engines found the same matches
notes: Mk Regex.FindAll into an arena Reset per pattern (forward DFA to each match's end, reverse DFA to its start; RX-1 and RX-2 of status/std-regex.md kept both DFAs on these classes); Go regexp FindAllStringIndex (its NFA or one-pass engine).
